versions.localizedDescription: Quiet Native redesign with an image-free visual system, clearer Today-to-completion flow, accessible controls and adaptive layouts, a non-celestial app icon, and preserved playback, downloads, progress, credentials, and backups.

MindSpace 2.4.0: Photorealistic AI Celestial Artworks, On-Demand Private GitHub Streaming & Singles Downloads. Fresh photorealistic 3D planet bodies with 100% native RGBA alpha transparency, serene deep-space App Icon render, seamless AVURLAsset online streaming from private GitHub repository, and category-level Singles downloads.

MindSpace 2.3.0: Cinematic Hybrid Celestial Visuals & Polished App Icon. Upgraded all 9 celestial planets with transparent alpha blending, atmospheric glowing coronas, mindful breathing physics, and polished iOS App Icon with deep cosmic lighting.

Private GitHub Content Sync & Selective Downloads: Integrated hardware-backed KeychainManager for PAT credentials, on-demand course downloading directly from private GitHub repositories with live progress and SHA-256 verification, Goal-Oriented Smart Sync, and new Library 'Available' filter.

Full Adversarial Remediation Release: Day-attached video intro sequencing (.video -> .audio), rolling 30-day persistent Compassion Passes, disjoint-interval listening union on resume, replay accumulator reset, 5-step cosmic onboarding with offline RecommendationEngine & Medical Disclaimer, accessible VoiceOver scrubber & constellation nodes, exact completion UUID reflection matching, truthful checksum & backup-exclusion auditing, primary Next Session button with Pregnancy gap handling, local-calendar Daily Journey scoping, restored 8-pack/15-singles library hierarchy with Work/Sport & duration filters, and reconciled notification authorization.

Curated 10m/30m/60m sleep sounds, zero-battery-drain animation isolation (CelestialBreathingAuraView & ActiveNodeView), GPU starfield rendering, AudioSessionManager hardware deactivation, DateFormatterCache allocations fix, retained haptic generators, and instant pre-indexed catalog search.
